name: Iceflower
description:
See where your customers really shop.
Iceflower turns real card and bank transactions into interactive market intelligence: merchant benchmarks, cross-shopping, catchment maps, customer movement and AI-assisted reports - for your brand and the competitors around it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Iceflower to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Iceflower to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.iceflower.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Iceflower MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Iceflower lists 15 MCP tools, including cross_shop, fetch, local_buyer_profile, mall_compare, mall_lookup, merchant_summary, merchants_in_area, retention_curve, revenue_timeseries, rfm_segments, rfm_table, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Iceflower?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Iceflower in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Iceflower requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Iceflower is developed by Iceflower GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
